chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from Abu Dawud al-Munshid, from Salamah, from Mughirah, the mu'adhdhin of Banu 'Adi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام washed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. He began with lote-tree leaves, and the second washing was with three mithqals of camphor and one mithqal of musk. Then he called for the third with a waterskin whose mouth was tied, and poured it over him; then he shrouded him, عليه السلام.

key_terms.السِّدْرِ: lote-tree leaves used in the first washing
key_terms.غَسَّلَ: performed the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.مِسْكٍ: musk used in the washing mixture

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali عليه السلام wash and prepare the body of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith reports how Imam Ali عليه السلام performed the ghusl of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, detailing the substances used in the washings and the final shrouding. It is significant for discussions of funerary rites, especially the procedure of washing and preparing the deceased.
